editorial: Every pedal‑powdered turn reveals a new burst of high‑speed humor that keeps you perched on the edge of your seat. Sonic the Hedgehog 2 makes the speedometer work its own brand of wit, pairing Tails’ earnest optimism with Jeff Fowler’s knack for splashy 2‑D graphics that feel like a living boardroom of neon. When Knuckles takes center stage, the film slows into a pulse‑quickening duel, demonstrating that even the fastest hero can stumble on a heavier emotional budget. The only hiccup comes in a mid‑act lull, where the pacing dips before the final sprint pulls you back into the fast‑track groove. Ideal for family viewers who crave action that is as bright with laughs as it is quick on thrills.
targetAudience: Ideal for families seeking an animated adventure that balances humor and heart.
